shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat /workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---NEXT VERSION---" && cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'
ls -la /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---APP DIR---" && ls -R /workspace/app 2>/dev/null && echo "---SRC DIR---" && ls -R /workspace/src 2>/dev/null
ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ && echo "---" && for f in /workspace/__agent_eval__/*; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace && (npx next start -p 3210 >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6 ; echo "=== server log ===" ; cat /tmp/next-start.log ; echo "=== GET /admin/catalog ===" ; curl -s http://localhost:3210/admin/catalog -o /tmp/catalog.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" ; echo "=== product names present? ===" ; grep -oE 'Laptop|Phone|Tablet|Headphones|Watch' /tmp/catalog.html | sort -u ; echo "=== form/action markup ===" ; grep -oE '<form[^>]*>|name="\\\$ACTION[^"]*"|Sync latest catalog' /tmp/catalog.html | head -40

cd /workspace && grep -oE '\$ACTION[A-Z_]*["=[:alnum:]_-]*' /tmp/catalog.html | sort -u ; echo "=== hidden inputs ===" ; grep -oE '<input[^>]*type="hidden"[^>]*>' /tmp/catalog.html | head ; echo "=== context around form (first 1200 chars after <form) ===" ; grep -oE '<form.*</form>' /tmp/catalog.html | head -c 1500

cd /workspace && ACTION_ID=$(grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' /tmp/catalog.html | head -1) && echo "action id: $ACTION_ID" && echo "=== POST sync (timed) ===" && time curl -s -o /tmp/post1.body -w "HTTP %{http_code} | %{size_download} bytes | %{time_total}s\n" -X POST http://localhost:3210/admin/catalog -H "Origin: http://localhost:3210" -H "Accept: text/x-component" -F "$ACTION_ID=" && echo "=== server log so far ===" && tail -20 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && echo "waiting 3s for after() to run 2s sync + revalidateTag..." && sleep 3 && echo "=== GET #1 (triggers SWR, likely serves stale prerender) ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3210/admin/catalog -o /tmp/get1.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" && grep -oE '>\$[0-9]+<' /tmp/get1.html | head && echo "=== server log ===" && tail -15 /tmp/next-start.log && echo "waiting 2s for background revalidation to finish..." && sleep 2 && echo "=== GET #2 (should be fresh) ===" && curl -s http://localhost:3210/admin/catalog -o /tmp/get2.html -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" && echo "--- prices in get2 ---" && grep -oE '>\$[0-9]+<' /tmp/get2.html | head && echo "--- syncedAt present? ---" && grep -oE '20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+' /tmp/get2.html | head && echo "--- server log ---" && tail -15 /tmp/next-start.log

cd /workspace && clean() { sed -E 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g; s/<[^>]+>/ /g' "$1" | tr -s ' ' '\n' | grep -E '^(Laptop|Phone|Tablet|Headphones|Watch|\$[0-9]+|[0-9]{4}-.*T.*)$' ; } && echo "=== ORIGINAL (catalog.html) ===" && grep -oE 'Laptop|Phone|Tablet|Headphones|Watch' /tmp/catalog.html >/dev/null && clean /tmp/catalog.html | grep -E 'Laptop|^\$|T[0-9]' | head -20 && echo && echo "=== GET #1 (right after sync; should be STALE: old \$, no T timestamp) ===" && grep -oE '20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+' /tmp/get1.html | head -1 ; clean /tmp/get1.html | grep -E 'Laptop|^\$' | head -8 && echo && echo "=== GET #2 (after revalidation; should be FRESH: new \$ + T timestamp) ===" && grep -oE '20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+' /tmp/get2.html | head -1 ; clean /tmp/get2.html | grep -E 'Laptop|^\$' | head -8
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo "server stopped"; cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "--- final files ---" && ls app/admin/catalog lib
cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "--- files ---" && ls -R app lib next.config.ts
cd /workspace && echo "=== package.json diff ===" && git diff package.json && echo "=== tsconfig.json diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
